skill.name: data-scientist
skill.description: Advanced data science guidance for analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, experiment design, visualization, and business intelligence workflows.
skill.summary: Plan and review data science workflows from exploration through model evaluation and stakeholder communication.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Data science projects often fail when goals, methods, and validation are unclear. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structure rigorous analysis workflows.
actual_capabilities: Frames analytical goals, constraints, required inputs, and verification steps.
Guides exploratory data analysis, profiling, missing value checks, and outlier review.
Recommends statistical methods, hypothesis tests, experiment designs, and causal inference approaches.
Plans machine learning workflows, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and interpretability.
Supports business analytics for marketing, finance, operations, forecasting, segmentation, and fraud detection.
Helps communicate findings through clear visualizations, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder recommendations.
limitations: Does not include executable analysis scripts or bundled data processing tools.
Cannot verify results without access to the user's data, assumptions, and evaluation outputs.
May require domain expert review for regulated, medical, legal, or financial decisions.
References broad tool ecosystems but does not install or configure them.

use_cases.title: Plan a Predictive Model
use_cases.description: Define features, labels, evaluation metrics, validation design, and deployment checks before model development begins.

use_cases.title: Analyze an Experiment
use_cases.description: Choose statistical tests, review assumptions, calculate practical impact, and prepare a clear decision summary.

use_cases.title: Create Executive Insights
use_cases.description: Turn exploratory findings into visual explanations, business implications, and recommended next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Scope an Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for defining a data science task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me scope a data science analysis for [business question]. Identify goals, needed data, assumptions, risks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Experiment
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for A/B testing or measurement planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an experiment for [change or campaign]. Include hypothesis, metrics, sample size considerations, statistical test, and decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Modeling Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for predictive modeling workflow review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this modeling plan for [prediction task]. Assess feature strategy, leakage risks, evaluation metrics, cross-validation, interpretability, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Analytics Roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for multi-stage analytics programs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an analytics roadmap for [domain or product area]. Cover data readiness, methods, experiments, model deployment, governance, and stakeholder reporting.

output_examples.input: Analyze churn risk for a subscription product.
output_examples.output: A structured plan covering churn definition, cohort selection, feature groups, leakage checks, baseline models, evaluation metrics, retention actions, and monitoring needs.

output_examples.input: Design an A/B test for a new checkout flow.
output_examples.output: An experiment outline with primary and guardrail metrics, randomization approach, sample size considerations, test duration, validity risks, and launch criteria.

output_examples.input: Explain sales forecast drivers to executives.
output_examples.output: A concise narrative that separates trend, seasonality, promotions, uncertainty, operational risks, and recommended decisions for planning.

best_practices: Start with the business decision, then select metrics and methods that support that decision.
Validate assumptions, data quality, and leakage risks before trusting model or test results.
Document methodology, limitations, and practical impact so stakeholders can review the work.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize model accuracy without checking whether the metric matches the business goal.
Do not treat correlation as causation without a valid experimental or causal design.
Do not present complex visualizations without explaining the decision they support.

faq.question: What types of data science work does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports analytics planning, exploratory analysis, statistics, machine learning, experiments, visualization, and business reporting.

faq.question: Can this skill run models or process datasets by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and review. Execution depends on the connected AI tool and available project files.

faq.question: Is this useful for non-technical stakeholders?
faq.answer: Yes. It can translate analytical methods into business questions, decisions, risks, and plain-language recommendations.

faq.question: Does it cover production machine learning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes deployment planning, model monitoring, drift checks, governance, and maintenance considerations.

faq.question: Can it help with experiment design?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline hypotheses, metrics, randomization, sample size considerations, statistical tests, and interpretation.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the business goal, available data, constraints, target audience, current method, and any known risks or assumptions.
